privacy.scope: clean source tree, all intended reachable Git history, source archive, npm tarball, literal deny rules
privacy.limits: Literal matching cannot prove absence of unknown private information or understand image, video, audio, alternate encodings, or opaque archives beyond supported formats.

credentials.limits: Pattern-based known credential shapes; seven matches are reviewed synthetic test fixtures, not claims of exhaustive secret absence.

advisories.limits: Registry advisory snapshot, not a guarantee against unknown or later advisories.

licenses.developmentOnlyException: Installed optional @rolldown/binding-darwin-arm64 declares MIT but has no own license file. Parent rolldown distribution has LICENSE and THIRD-PARTY-LICENSE. This optional development binding is not included in the published package.
licenses.limits: License metadata and notices checked; this is not a legal opinion.

publicArtifacts.priorReviewScope: Full video decode and sampled visual frames, not every-frame human review. Known scenario-title redaction blemish remains disclosed.
publicArtifacts.contextReview: No absolute home paths in current evidence and demo context scan. Some historical evidence cites local temporary paths; those references are not portable.

methodLimits: No browser, VM, Docker, media regeneration, publication, source mutation, or extra comparison performed.
Current proof is bound to this exact commit, archive, package and spec. A later handoff commit or archive requires new final identity and affected review.
No G20 pass or overall release-readiness claim is made.
